message:
- **You push it**, Instructions: Reports & Analytics → Reports Dashboard (or Custom Reports → Standard) → run Employee Census, Employee Profile, Payroll History, and Voluntary Deductions → download each as CSV/XLS; time data separately via Time & Attendance → Maintenance → Payroll → Exports → New Export. Lands as one file per report on your disk, plus tax form PDFs from Reports & Analytics → Federal/State/Local Tax Documents → iReports.

Let me know if you have any questions about this.
notes: Each report is run and downloaded individually; time data and tax documents come from separate areas of the product.
